/* BrokerMapper.selectBrokerMasterSubList : broker-M House 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT A.* , COUNT(A.HBL_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT , SUM(A.HBL_PIECES) OVER() AS SUM_PIECES , SUM(A.HBL_GWT) OVER() AS SUM_GWT FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.CB_CODE ,od.MRN ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE AND CUSTOMER_TYPE ='BR') AS CB_NAME ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_CODE ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,ad.DROP_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'DROP_CODE' AND CODE = ad.DROP_CODE) AS DROP_REASON ,ad.XRAY_YN
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = ad.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS
,od.GE_INSPECTION_YN ,od.INSPECTION_TYPE ,ad.FOOD_YN ,ad.SPLIT_WAIST_YN ,od.PO_DATE ,od.PO_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CLEARANCE_STATUS' AND CODE = ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS) AS CLEARANCE_STATUS_NAME ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.AR_DATE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.CARRYIN_DATE, '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS CARRYIN_YN ,od.FTA_YN
,od.CLEARANCE_NOTICE_YN ,od.CLEARANCE_NOTICE_DATE
,ISNULL(ad.INVOICE_YN, 'N') AS INVOICE_YN
,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'DTY') AS TARIFF ,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'TAX') AS SURTAX ,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'CFC') AS CLEARANCE_FEE ,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'QUA') AS QURANTINE_FEE ,((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(AR_AMOUNT),0) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'SPTAX') +(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(AR_AMOUNT),0) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'OHTAX') +(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(AR_AMOUNT),0) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'EDTAX') )AS ETC_FEE
,ad.TAX_PAY_FOR_YN ,ad.PRINT_YN
,od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AND CUSTOMER_TYPE ='HC') AS CUST_NAME_LV1 ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_NAME_LV2 ,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,od.PIECES_REAL AS HBL_PIECES ,od.GWT AS HBL_GWT ,od.CBM ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS010' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS010_CNT ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS030' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS030_CNT
,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON,'') != '' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS040_CNT ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS050' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS050_CNT
,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE
,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC
,(SELECT CONCAT(od.CD_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' AND CODE = od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE ,(SELECT CONCAT(od.CD_USE_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN' AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE) AS CD_USE_TYPE ,(SELECT CONCAT(od.ECM_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE
,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE
,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE') AS ECM_TYPE_NAME ,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.AGENT_NAME ,od.SELLER_REG_NO ,od.SELLER_NAME ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO ,od.SALES_BROKER_NAME ,STUFF((SELECT ',' + PO_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_PO_INFO WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')) ,1 ,1, '') AS PO_NO_LIST
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CB_IF_STATUS' AND CODE = ad.CB_IF_STATUS) AS CB_IF_STATUS ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_TYPE' AND CODE = ad.CCL_TYPE) AS CCL_TYPE
,od.ECM_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
)A

/* BrokerMapper.selectBrokerHouseList : broker-H 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT A.* , COUNT(A.HBL_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT , SUM(A.HBL_PIECES) OVER() AS SUM_PIECES , SUM(A.HBL_GWT) OVER() AS SUM_GWT FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.CB_CODE ,od.MRN ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE AND CUSTOMER_TYPE ='BR') AS CB_NAME ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_CODE ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,ad.DROP_YN ,ad.DROP_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'DROP_CODE' AND CODE = ad.DROP_CODE) AS DROP_REASON ,ad.XRAY_YN

,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS
,od.GE_INSPECTION_YN ,od.INSPECTION_TYPE ,od.PO_NO ,od.PO_DATE ,od.OB_DATE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.CBM ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.FTA_YN
,od.CLEARANCE_NOTICE_YN ,od.CLEARANCE_NOTICE_DATE
,ad.FOOD_YN ,ad.SPLIT_WAIST_YN ,ad.TAX_PAY_FOR_YN ,ad.PRINT_YN
,od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_NAME_LV1 ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_NAME_LV2 ,ad.INVOICE_YN ,ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS ,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE ,od.PIECES_REAL AS HBL_PIECES ,od.GWT AS HBL_GWT ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS010' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS010_CNT ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS030' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS030_CNT
,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON, '') != '' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS040_CNT ,COUNT(CASE ad.CLEARANCE_STATUS WHEN 'CLS050' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS CLS050_CNT
,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE
,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC
,(SELECT CONCAT(od.CD_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' AND CODE = od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE ,(SELECT CONCAT(od.CD_USE_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN' AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE) AS CD_USE_TYPE ,(SELECT CONCAT(od.ECM_TYPE, '(', NAME_${userLanguage}, ')') FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE
,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE
,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE') AS ECM_TYPE_NAME ,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.AGENT_NAME ,od.SELLER_REG_NO ,od.SELLER_NAME ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO ,od.SALES_BROKER_NAME ,STUFF((SELECT ',' + PO_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_PO_INFO WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')) ,1 ,1, '') AS PO_NO_LIST
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CB_IF_STATUS' AND CODE = ad.CB_IF_STATUS) AS CB_IF_STATUS ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_TYPE' AND CODE = ad.CCL_TYPE) AS CCL_TYPE
,od.ECM_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
)A

/* BrokerMapper.selectBrokerHouseSubList : broker-H 금액 조회 */
SELECT A.* ,ISNULL(TARIFF,0)+ISNULL(SURTAX,0)+ISNULL(SPECIAL_CONSUMTION_TAX,0)+ISNULL(LIQUOR_TAX,0)+ISNULL(EDUCATION_TAX,0)+ISNULL(RURAL_SPECIAL_TAX,0) AS TOT_FEE ,ISNULL(TARIFF,0)+ISNULL(SURTAX,0)+ISNULL(SPECIAL_CONSUMTION_TAX,0)+ISNULL(LIQUOR_TAX,0)+ISNULL(EDUCATION_TAX,0)+ISNULL(RURAL_SPECIAL_TAX,0) + ISNULL(CLEARANCE_FEE,0)+ISNULL(QURANTINE_FEE,0)+ISNULL(WAREHOUSE_FEE,0) AS TOT_AMT FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(ad.TAX_EXCHANGE_RATE) AS TAX_EXCHANGE_RATE ,MAX(ad.TAX_FREIGHT) AS TAX_FREIGHT ,MAX(ad.CIF_LOCAL) AS CIF_LOCAL ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DTY' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS TARIFF ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'TAX' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS SURTAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'SPTAX' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS SPECIAL_CONSUMTION_TAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'OHTAX' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS LIQUOR_TAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'EDTAX' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS EDUCATION_TAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'AGRTX' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS RURAL_SPECIAL_TAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'CFC' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS CLEARANCE_FEE ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'QUA' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS QURANTINE_FEE ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WHC' THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT END) AS WAREHOUSE_FEE
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AND GROUP_CODE = 'CB_IF_STATUS' AND CODE = MAX(ad.CB_IF_STATUS)) AS CB_IF_STATUS ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_TYPE' AND CODE = MAX(ad.CCL_TYPE)) AS CCL_TYPE
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO ) A

/* BrokerMapper.updateBrokerBatch : Broker - 일괄변경 */
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD SET CB_CODE = #{CbCode} WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET CLEARANCE_STATUS = 'CLS050' WHERE
OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD SET CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE = #{clearanceViolationCode} ,CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON = #{clearanceViolationReason} WHERE
OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS COUNT

/* BrokerMapper.updateBrokerBatch2 : Broker - 통관상태 일괄변경 */
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET CLEARANCE_STATUS = 'CLS030' WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
UPDATE ad SET CLEARANCE_STATUS = 'CLS040' FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS COUNT

/* BrokerMapper.selectBrokerBatchBySrchData : Broker - 통관상태 일괄변경 */
SELECT OD_JOB_NO, od.MBL_NO, od.HBL_NO, BOUND , BOUND_TYPE FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo}
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
AND od.CUST_CODE_LV1 = #{custCodeLv1} AND ISNULL(od.CUST_CODE_LV2,'') = #{custCodeLv2}
AND 1 = 0
SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO, od.MBL_NO, od.HBL_NO, od.BOUND , od.BOUND_TYPE FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})

/* BrokerMapper.selectCustomsShipmentRequestList : 로그인네트웍 LCSV2 API - 수입 신고 요청 정보 전송 대상건 조회 */ SELECT
od.HBL_NO , od.CB_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE AND CUSTOMER_TYPE ='BR') AS CB_NAME , od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE , od.PO_NO , od.URL , od.CD_TYPE , od.INCOTERMS , od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE , od.CD_USE_TYPE , od.INSPECTION_TYPE , ad.DROP_CODE , od.FTA_YN , ROUND(od.GWT, 2) AS GWT , od.PIECES , od.MBL_NO , CONVERT(CHAR(8), od.AR_DATE, 112) AS AR_DATE , od.ORIG_COUNTRY , od.OD_JOB_NO
, od.SHIPPER_NAME , CONCAT(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS , CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_HP, '') = '' THEN od.SHIPPER_TEL ELSE od.SHIPPER_HP END AS SHIPPER_TEL , od.ECM_BUY_TYPE , od.SELLER_REG_NO , od.AGENT_NAME , od.AGENT_REG_NO , od.SALES_BROKER_NAME , od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO
, od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC , od.CUSTOMS_ID , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC , od.CONSIGNEE_HP , od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
,'[' + STUFF(( SELECT ',{DETAIL_ITEM_NAME:"' + ISNULL(REPLACE(DETAIL_ITEM_NAME, '"',''), '') + '",BRAND:"' + ISNULL(BRAND, '') + '",UNIT_PRICE:"' + CAST(CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,2), UNIT_PRICE) AS VARCHAR) + '",PIECES:"' + CAST(CAST(ISNULL(PIECES,1) AS INT) AS VARCHAR) + '",AMOUNT:"' + CAST(CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,2), AMOUNT) AS VARCHAR) + '",GWT:"' + CAST(CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,3), GWT) AS VARCHAR) + '",CURRENCY_CODE:"' + ISNULL(CURRENCY_CODE, '') + '",HS_CODE:"' + ISNULL(HS_CODE, '') + '",ORIGIN_COUNTRY:"' + ISNULL(ORIGIN_COUNTRY, '') + '"}' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM items WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = items.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY items.SEQ_NO_ID FOR XML PATH ('') ) + ']', 1, 1, '') AS ITEMS_INFO FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO

/* BrokerMapper.selectCustomsOfficerList2 : 관세사 리스트 조회 2 */ SELECT MAX(od.CB_CODE) AS CB_CODE , COUNT(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS HBL_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.CB_CODE ORDER BY od.CB_CODE
